target.title: Fix Gemini helper timeout reliability
target.body:
## Summary

- Make synchronous Gemini package-discovery waits independent of termination-handler callback scheduling.
- Preserve monotonic deadlines and hard process-group termination for stuck helpers.
- Add a direct regression for delayed successful output and first-line extraction.
- Keep the PR provider-scoped; the temporary global CI-timeout increase was removed.
- Document the user-visible reliability fix in the changelog.

## Proof

- `swift test --no-parallel --filter '^CodexBarTests.GeminiStatusProbeAPITests/'` — 19 tests passed, repeated five times on final head.
- `make check` — repository guards, links, locale parity, SwiftFormat, and SwiftLint passed; 0 lint violations across 1,245 files.
- `make test` — all 46 shards passed on the runtime implementation before the final proof-only regression/current-main merge; exact-head CI validates the integrated candidate.
- Installed `fnm` live path — `fnm current` returned `v25.8.1` in 0.00s and `fnm exec --using v25.8.1 npm root -g` returned the global root in 0.10s; no Gemini credential read or provider request was needed.
- Autoreview — clean, no accepted/actionable findings (0.83 confidence).

## Risk

Low and provider-scoped. The helper remains synchronous and bounded, still escalates to hard process-group termination after the deadline, and now has direct success, no-output failure, inherited-pipe, and ignored-SIGTERM coverage.
